details.method: supplied grayscale height -> Gaussian blur radius1.5px -> central gradients -> normalize(-8*dx,+8*dy,1); RGB=(n+1)/2; 4px alpha-edge exclusion resets normal flat
details.normal_convention: Godot X+, Y+, Z+; green positive for increasing raster height slope downward
details.bitmap_use: Registered supplied bitmap as restrained specular mask; source is a tonal guide, not physically authored roughness
details.registration_limitations: Silhouette registration only; grayscale panels are generated tonal interpretations. Internal feature correspondence requires actual art review; no nonrigid warping.

details.stage: reusable editable prefab; native instantiation and graphical resource review passed
details.notes: Bottom-center origin; native diffuse496x687; no collision or occluder blocks arch opening; no nonexistent emitter. Supplied grayscale depth-derived bump +bitmap CanvasTexture. Silhouette overlap .881/.908; interior feature registration remains approximate.
